description: This file contains an abstract class implementation for JSON Web Tokens (JWT), providing core parsing and access methods for JWT components such as header, payload, signature, and claims.

classes.name: AbstractJsonWebToken
classes.description: An abstract implementation of the JsonWebToken interface, providing parsing, validation, and access to JWT components.

methods.name: AbstractJsonWebToken(JsonWebToken)
methods.description: Constructor that clones an existing JSON Web Token instance.

methods.name: AbstractJsonWebToken(String)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the JWT by parsing the token string into header, payload, and signature.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the JWT header as a JsonObject.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the JWT payload as a JsonObject.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Returns the raw JWT token string.

methods.name: getKeyId
methods.description: Retrieves the 'kid' (Key ID) from the JWT header.

methods.name: getIssuer
methods.description: Retrieves the 'iss' (Issuer) claim from the JWT payload.

methods.name: getAudience
methods.description: Returns the 'aud' (Audience) claim as an Audience object.

methods.name: getAuthorizedParty
methods.description: Returns the 'azp' (Authorized Party) claim, or empty string if absent.

methods.name: getScopes
methods.description: Returns the 'scope' claim as a list of scope strings.

methods.name: getExpirationTime
methods.description: Returns the expiration time ('exp' claim) as an Instant.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks whether the JWT has expired based on current time and 'exp' claim.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Equality check based on token, header, body, and signature.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Hash code implementation consistent with equals.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: String representation of the JWT including its components.
